clusters.headline: FSSAI Expands Water Checks Following Bisleri Unsafe Sample Finding
aiSummaryBullets: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) is initiating nationwide tests across all packaged water brands.
The move follows legal action against Bisleri International regarding a single water sample from a September 2025 batch that allegedly exceeded bromate limits.

clusters.headline: Prime Minister Modi Holds Bilateral Talks With Nepal PM Balen Shah
aiSummaryBullets: Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah is on his first official state visit to India to engage in bilateral discussions with Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
The leaders are focusing on strengthening ties through agreements related to energy, infrastructure, technology, and trade connectivity.

clusters.headline: Congress And Samajwadi Party Begin Seat-Sharing Talks In Uttar Pradesh
aiSummaryBullets: Congress and Samajwadi Party leaders met to discuss a potential seat-sharing arrangement for the Uttar Pradesh assembly polls.
The ongoing negotiations involve four designated representatives from each of the two political parties.

clusters.headline: Defence Ministry Finalizes INS Betwa Propulsion Refit Contract
aiSummaryBullets: The Ministry of Defence entered into a ₹498 crore agreement to refit the INS Betwa.
The contract focuses specifically on the vessel's propulsion system upgrade.

clusters.headline: PM Modi And Nepal Prime Minister Hold Bilateral Talks In New Delhi
aiSummaryBullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and the Nepal Prime Minister held formal bilateral discussions regarding energy, trade, and connectivity.
The leaders participated in a cultural gift exchange featuring items including Ganges water, sandalwood, and sacred rudraksh beads.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Review Filed Over Karthigai Deepam Lighting Dispute
aiSummaryBullets: The Tamil Nadu state government submitted a petition to the Supreme Court seeking a review of its interim order concerning Karthigai Deepam.
The legal challenge focuses on the court's permission for one-time lighting ceremonies at the Thiruparankundram hill location.

clusters.headline: Delhi Air Quality Records Poor Levels Amid Pollution Control Plans
aiSummaryBullets: Delhi's air quality has reached a poor level with an air quality index of 249.
The Commission for Air Quality Management is currently assessing pollution control strategies.

clusters.headline: Kerala High Court Issues Rulings On Legal And Administrative Cases
aiSummaryBullets: The Kerala High Court quashed the suspension of students at a Sanskrit university and ordered the institution to hold their deferred examinations.
Judicial proceedings continue regarding local disputes, including the dismissal of a disproportionate assets case against Minister K.M. Shaji.

clusters.headline: PM Modi Inaugurates New Railway Link Connecting Ayodhya And Janakpur
aiSummaryBullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the direct rail service between Ayodhya and Janakpur.
The connection aims to strengthen the historical, emotional, and cultural relationship between India and Nepal.

clusters.headline: TVK MLA V.S. Babu, Who Defeated M.K. Stalin, Has Passed Away
aiSummaryBullets: TVK legislator V.S. Babu has died following a 71-day period of medical treatment.
Babu previously gained political recognition for winning the Kolathur assembly constituency over M.K. Stalin.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Rejects Separate Hearing Plea on Election Law Verdict
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court denied a request to separately list a petition challenging a split verdict concerning the appointment of election commissioners.
Judges declined to alter the current handling of the legal challenge, maintaining that the court would not facilitate a special hearing process.

clusters.headline: BJP Criticizes Rahul Gandhi Over Recent Comments and Social Media Posts
aiSummaryBullets: BJP leaders have criticized Rahul Gandhi for his recent social media post depicting an Ardhanareshwar image, which he used to target the party.
The BJP has also condemned comments made by Rahul Gandhi regarding India's economy and his purported avoidance of parliamentary debates.

clusters.headline: Nikhil Gupta Sentenced To 19 Years For Sikh Separatist Plot In US
aiSummaryBullets: Nikhil Gupta received a 19-year prison sentence for his role in a conspiracy to murder a Sikh activist in New York City.
The defendant pleaded guilty to multiple charges including murder-for-hire, conspiracy to commit murder, and money laundering earlier this year.

clusters.headline: Gold Price Crashes Amid Ongoing Market Volatility In India
aiSummaryBullets: Gold prices have fallen to a one-year low, dropping significantly from recent record highs.
Silver prices have also experienced a sharp decline of approximately Rs 2.46 lakh.

clusters.headline: Pakistan Minister Musadik Malik Joins SCO Forum Amid Delhi Tensions
aiSummaryBullets: Pakistan Minister Musadik Malik attended the SCO Civilisational Dialogue in New Delhi, sparking political debate in India.
The forum concluded with the adoption of an outcome document highlighting the role of shared history and cultural exchange among SCO members.

clusters.headline: US Report Links China Support For Pakistan To Operation Sindoor
aiSummaryBullets: A recent US congressional report claims China provided critical military and economic aid to Pakistan during Operation Sindoor.
The analysis suggests Beijing utilized these tactics to deliberately counteract India’s strategic and economic advancement in the region.

clusters.headline: Delhi Police Apprehend Teen For Selling Stolen Agniveer Data Online
aiSummaryBullets: A 14-year-old minor was apprehended by Delhi Police for allegedly hacking the Agniveer recruitment examination website.
Investigators report the teenager utilized AI chatbot technology to gain unauthorized access to the portal's system.

clusters.headline: Nine Pilgrims Killed In Rajasthan Road Collision Near Kota
aiSummaryBullets: A vehicle transporting pilgrims back from Khatu Shyam collided with a stationary truck in Rajasthan's Kota district.
Nine individuals died in the incident, while six others sustained injuries and are currently receiving medical treatment.

clusters.headline: Amit Shah Discusses Development And Siang Dam In Arunachal Pradesh
aiSummaryBullets: Amit Shah stated the Vibrant Villages Programme has improved infrastructure and encouraged reverse migration in Arunachal Pradesh border areas.
Proponents of the Siang dam project have pledged dialogue with local protesters while maintaining that traditional practices will be protected.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Grants Bail To Two Convicts In Bilkis Bano Case
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court of India suspended the life sentences and granted bail to two convicts in the Bilkis Bano case.
Court documentation indicates the decision was based on the fact that both men served over 17 years in prison, with one having a severe disability.
